text:
IncidentBot: [Pager] metering-alert: token-emitter-gap detected in us-west-2. Missing emits >10% over 5m for production windowing. Runbook: /runbooks/metering/emit-gap. Pager routed to oncall: @maya.

maya: taking it — oncall here, thanks. quick status?

jared: I see a surge of 502/503 from emitter-proxy between 01:22-01:30 UTC; retry amplification + backlog. grabbing logs now. grep shows repeated upstream_timeout on proxy -> kv-ingest.

anika: billing visibility: delayed usage snapshots from windowing-service. Some windows are showing 20-40m lag; overage flags fired for a small cohort (high-volume customers).

priya: customer-impact: one enterprise customer flagged us (billing email) about a sudden spike. CS triage taking contact. Will need a short external note if this persists.

maya: immediate mitigation: scale emitter-proxy replicas + enable safe_debounce flag to collapse retries. rolling patch now.

deploy-bot: Deployment started by maya: kubectl -n metering scale deploy/emitter-proxy --replicas=8

jared: running quick health check:
```
# check upstream error rate
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=emitter_upstream_5xx&window=5m" | jq .value
```
observed 5xx rate drop after scaling begins. still seeing backlog in redis-kv (pending writes ~ 23k).

zed: rerouting writes for bursty keyspace to secondary-emitter cluster to relieve primary. set route weight 0.2 -> secondary. Also toggled flag: `safe_debounce=true` on /flags/service.

anika: proposal: pause automated overage alerting for affected windows (T-00..T-40) while we reconcile to avoid noisy customer notifications. Requesting approval from ops lead + finance for credits.

priya: ack, I'll prep a templated message for customers: one short explanation, apology, and ETA for reconciliation. DM me the affected account IDs.

maya: backfill plan: run incremental backfill for missing windows after primary backlog drains. run command: `./jobs/backfill-usage --start 2024-11-21T01:00Z --end 2024-11-21T02:00Z --dry-run` then remove dry-run when checks pass. assigning jared to own the backfill.

jared: starting dry-run now. ETA for actual backfill (if dry-run clean) ~45m. will post progress.

IncidentBot: Incident created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1758888888 ; severity: sev2 (billing-impacting). Pager rotations updated.

anika: finance hold: will need approval for credits once customer impact confirmed. pinging @finance.

priya: CS note drafted, waiting for account list. once backfill completes we'll send an update and offer credit if invoices were impacted.

maya: monitoring: added temporary dashboard with emit-lag, 5xx-rate, pending-backlog. alert thresholds lowered for the next 2 hours.

zed: I’ve taken over watch after handoff (in 15m). will keep traffic routed to secondary until backlog <2k and 5xx <0.5%. reopen page if delta >5% or overage flags re-fire.

maya: handing off to @zed now. jared/anika/priya: keep running comms + reconciliation. postmortem owner: jared.

jared: noted. creating incident doc with timeline and logs attachment. initial hypothesis: emitter-proxy transient overload + retry amplification causing delayed writes -> windowing miscounts and overage flags.

maya: thanks team. I’m signing off on active mitigation, moving to monitoring-only. ping me if escalation needed. :thumbsup:

zed: ack, monitoring. I’ll post a closure update once backfill completes and overage flags are cleared.

priya: will draft the customer follow-up and coordinate credits after reconciliation.

anika: temporary mitigation checklist: pause alerting, escalate finance, run backfill, mark impacted invoices for review.

jared: progress update (T+22m): dry-run backfill passed validation, scheduling actual backfill in 5m. expect counts to normalize within 30-40m post-backfill.

maya: great. thanks everyone. incident remains open until reconciliation & customer comms done.
